product_base.title: GuruNanda Whitening Strips, 7-day treatment (7 Packets - 2 Strips per pack) - Non-Slip, Dry Strip Technology

specifications.name: Ingredients
specifications.value: PVP K30,Glycerin,Hydroxypropyl cellulose,PVP K90,Water,Alcohol,Hydrogen peroxide,Menthol,Coconut Oil.

text_attribute.text: 7 strip sets for 7 days of treatment = 5 professional + 2 express sets.
1 strip set = 2 strips: 1 for top teeth, 1 for bottom teeth.

GOOD FOR SENSITIVE TEETH: Infused with natural coconut oil, Guru Nanda Coconut Teeth Whitening Strips are a great solution for teeth whitening for sensitive teeth and gums. It can help reduce tooth and gum sensitivity caused by hydrogen peroxide. The pure coconut oil in our strip help refresh your breath and clean your teeth.

NO MESS STRIP TECHNOLOGY: Our strips offer superior adhesion for hassle-free application & stay put for up to 60 minutes for effectively whiter teeth. For best results, avoid eating, sleeping, or smoking while using the strips.

HYDROGEN PEROXIDE: It is effective in whitening teeth due to its ability to break down and lift stains. When applied to the teeth, it releases oxygen molecules that penetrate the tooth enamel. These oxygen molecules react with the compounds causing discoloration or staining, breaking them apart and making the stains less concentrated, hence leading to a brighter appearance for the teeth.

PROFESSIONAL WHITENING: Whiten your teeth with our easy-to-use kit! Apply the strips once a day for 30-45 minutes and notice visible results in 3-5 days. Our kit includes  5 professional strip sets and 2 express strip sets with a total of 7 sets containing top and bottom strips to get you ready for a glamorous amazing-looking white smile.

EXPRESS WHITENING: Our 4 express whitening strips with 2 sets of top and bottom strips can be applied to see results in 1 day. Apply them once a day for 60 minutes and you will see instant results. The express treatment is great for special occasions as it will successfully brighten your smile after one use, making it great for fast teeth whitening.
HARD STAINS REMOVAL: Our strips help to remove tough stains from coffee, wine, and smoking for a brighter and whiter smile.

SAFE & PURPOSEFUL INGREDIENTS: Our strips are made in an FDA-registered facility. No harmful ingredients, no preservatives, additives, or artificial dyes or flavorings. Never tested on animals. Enamel safe and vegan.
